request.description: Runs this version (draft or later) against test profiles: screening (category, segment, sub-segment, amount, tenure, coverage) and three-valued eligibility per rule, next to the published version, with `changed` when the outcome differs. A profile may name a `partyId` to start from that party's stored facts; `facts` override them; `directors` and `coApplicants` feed party-scoped rules. Staff only. Lender products are versioned config (an ops lead or lender manager makes, a different staff member approves in Change Requests, then it is published). The key is `<lenderKey>.<productKey>`; the lender comes from the key. `content`: `category`, `segments`, `subSegments` (empty = all), `amountPaise` and `tenureMonths` ranges, `coverage` (`nationwide`, `states` as GST codes, `cityIds`, `includePincodes`, `excludePincodes`), `eligibility.hard[]` / `soft[]` rules (`id`, `when` condition, optional `minProvenance`, `party`: primary / any_co_applicant / all_directors, `pass` / `fail` texts; soft rules carry a `weight`), `documents[]` slots with a `stage`, optional `questionSet` and `pricingDisclosure`. Only products of active lenders with an agreement in force count for category availability, lender questions and matching.
